//go:build integration

package integration

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain/repository"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/infrastructure/persistence/postgres"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/migrations"
	"github.com/google/uuid"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgxpool"
)

// This suite requires an explicitly supplied, isolated proof database. It never
// drops a schema and uses the production migration runner, including checksums.
func TestLessonCompletionCutoverPostgres(t *testing.T) {
	databaseURL := os.Getenv("LESSON_COMPLETION_TEST_DATABASE_URL")
	if databaseURL == "" {
		t.Skip("set LESSON_COMPLETION_TEST_DATABASE_URL to an isolated loopback *_integration_proof database")
	}
	config, err := pgxpool.ParseConfig(databaseURL)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if !(config.ConnConfig.Host == "127.0.0.1" || config.ConnConfig.Host == "localhost" || config.ConnConfig.Host == "::1") || !strings.HasSuffix(config.ConnConfig.Database, "_integration_proof") {
		t.Fatal("lesson completion proof requires isolated loopback *_integration_proof database")
	}
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 2*time.Minute)
	defer cancel()
	pool, err := pgxpool.New(ctx, databaseURL)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer pool.Close()
	if err = pool.Ping(ctx); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var migrated bool
	if err = pool.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name='student_learning_path_item' AND column_name='lesson_revision_id')`).Scan(&migrated); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	legacyStudent, legacyPath, legacyLesson := uuid.NewString(), uuid.NewString(), uuid.NewString()
	if !migrated {
		prefix := t.TempDir()
		files, err := migrations.Discover(completionProofMigrationDirectory(t))
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		for _, file := range files {
			if file.Filename >= "030_" {
				continue
			}
			if err = os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(prefix, file.Filename), []byte(file.SQL), 0600); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
		}
		completionProofMigrate(t, ctx, databaseURL, prefix)
		if _, err = pool.Exec(ctx, `INSERT INTO student_learning_path(id,student_id,course_id,goal_code,curriculum_revision,policy_version,planner_policy_version,reason_code,reason_summary,version,created_at,updated_at) VALUES($1,$2,$3,'go.backend','r10',$4,'course-planner-v1','initial_plan','legacy cutover fixture',1,now(),now())`, legacyPath, legacyStudent, uuid.NewString(), domain.LearningPathPolicyVersion); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if _, err = pool.Exec(ctx, `INSERT INTO student_learning_path_item(student_learning_path_id,reference_type,reference_id,position,status,reason_code) VALUES($1,'lesson',$2,0,'READY','first_current_gap')`, legacyPath, legacyLesson); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	completionProofMigrate(t, ctx, databaseURL, completionProofMigrationDirectory(t))
	repo := &postgres.LearningJourneyRepoPG{Pool: pool}
	if !migrated {
		t.Run("legacy_rows_keep_no_historical_revision", func(t *testing.T) {
			path, err := repo.GetLearningPathByID(ctx, legacyStudent, legacyPath)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			if len(path.Items) != 1 || path.Items[0].ID == "" || path.Items[0].LessonRevisionID != "" || len(path.Items[0].FrozenRequirements) != 0 || path.Items[0].Status != domain.LearningPathItemReady {
				t.Fatalf("fabricated legacy history: %+v", path.Items)
			}
		})
	} else {
		t.Log("database already migrated: pre-cutover seed assertion verified only on first fresh run")
	}

	newPath := func(t *testing.T, types ...string) domain.StudentLearningPath {
		t.Helper()
		now := time.Now().UTC()
		path := completionProofLearningPath(uuid.NewString(), uuid.NewString(), uuid.NewString(), uuid.NewString(), now)
		item := &path.Items[0]
		item.ID = uuid.NewString()
		item.LessonRevisionID = uuid.NewString()
		item.LessonContent = json.RawMessage(`{"title":"R10"}`)
		item.Targets = []domain.LearningTargetRef{{Type: domain.LearningTargetConcept, Key: "loops", Version: "v1"}}
		for _, kind := range types {
			r := domain.LessonRequirement{ID: uuid.NewString(), ActivityID: uuid.NewString(), Type: kind, Required: true, SourceReference: domain.LessonSourceReference{ID: uuid.NewString()}}
			if kind != "theory_acknowledged" {
				r.SourceReference.RevisionID = uuid.NewString()
			}
			if kind == "practice_completed" {
				r.SourceReference.ID = r.SourceReference.RevisionID
			}
			item.FrozenRequirements = append(item.FrozenRequirements, r)
		}
		created, replayed, err := repo.CreateLearningPathIdempotently(ctx, path, repository.LearningPathCreationRequest{IdempotencyKey: uuid.NewString(), PlanningRequestID: uuid.NewString(), RequestHash: strings.Repeat("a", 64)})
		if err != nil || replayed {
			t.Fatalf("create frozen path: replay=%v err=%v", replayed, err)
		}
		return created
	}
	factFor := func(path domain.StudentLearningPath, index int) domain.LessonActivityFact {
		item := path.Items[0]
		r := item.FrozenRequirements[index]
		return domain.LessonActivityFact{StudentID: path.StudentID, ItemID: item.ID, RequirementID: r.ID, Type: r.Type, SourceID: r.SourceReference.ID, SourceRevisionID: r.SourceReference.RevisionID, FactID: uuid.NewString(), OccurredAt: time.Now().UTC()}
	}
	load := func(t *testing.T, path domain.StudentLearningPath) domain.StudentLearningPath {
		t.Helper()
		v, e := repo.GetLearningPathByID(ctx, path.StudentID, path.ID)
		if e != nil {
			t.Fatal(e)
		}
		return v
	}
	apply := func(t *testing.T, fact domain.LessonActivityFact) {
		t.Helper()
		if _, _, e := repo.ApplyLessonFact(ctx, fact); e != nil {
			t.Fatal(e)
		}
	}

	t.Run("A_theory_only", func(t *testing.T) {
		path := newPath(t, "theory_acknowledged")
		apply(t, factFor(path, 0))
		if load(t, path).Items[0].Status != domain.LearningPathItemCompleted {
			t.Fatal("theory acknowledgment did not complete item")
		}
	})
	t.Run("B_theory_and_quiz", func(t *testing.T) {
		path := newPath(t, "theory_acknowledged", "quiz_passed")
		apply(t, factFor(path, 0))
		if load(t, path).Items[0].Status == domain.LearningPathItemCompleted {
			t.Fatal("quiz requirement was ignored")
		}
		apply(t, factFor(path, 1))
		if load(t, path).Items[0].Status != domain.LearningPathItemCompleted {
			t.Fatal("passed quiz did not complete item")
		}
	})
	t.Run("C_practice_exact_correlation", func(t *testing.T) {
		path := newPath(t, "practice_completed")
		fact := factFor(path, 0)
		wrong := fact
		wrong.SourceRevisionID = uuid.NewString()
		if _, _, err := repo.ApplyLessonFact(ctx, wrong); !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrConflict) {
			t.Fatalf("mismatched revision error: %v", err)
		}
		if load(t, path).Items[0].FrozenRequirements[0].Satisfied {
			t.Fatal("mismatch mutated requirement")
		}
		apply(t, fact)
		if load(t, path).Items[0].Status != domain.LearningPathItemCompleted {
			t.Fatal("practice did not complete item")
		}
	})
	t.Run("D_all_required_activities", func(t *testing.T) {
		path := newPath(t, "theory_acknowledged", "quiz_passed", "task_passed", "practice_completed")
		for i := range path.Items[0].FrozenRequirements {
			apply(t, factFor(path, i))
			completed := load(t, path).Items[0].Status == domain.LearningPathItemCompleted
			if completed != (i == 3) {
				t.Fatalf("completion after %d activities: %v", i+1, completed)
			}
		}
	})
	t.Run("E_failed_attempt_is_not_success", func(t *testing.T) {
		path := newPath(t, "quiz_passed")
		wrong := factFor(path, 0)
		wrong.Type = "quiz_failed"
		if _, _, err := repo.ApplyLessonFact(ctx, wrong); err == nil {
			t.Fatal("failure accepted as successful fact")
		}
		if load(t, path).Items[0].Status == domain.LearningPathItemCompleted {
			t.Fatal("failure completed lesson")
		}
	})
	t.Run("F_duplicate_fact_is_replay_stable", func(t *testing.T) {
		path := newPath(t, "practice_completed")
		fact := factFor(path, 0)
		apply(t, fact)
		before := load(t, path)
		apply(t, fact)
		after := load(t, path)
		if before.Version != after.Version {
			t.Fatalf("duplicate advanced version: %d -> %d", before.Version, after.Version)
		}
		fact.SourceID = uuid.NewString()
		if _, _, err := repo.ApplyLessonFact(ctx, fact); err == nil {
			t.Fatal("same fact identity accepted different payload")
		}
	})
	t.Run("G_out_of_order_facts", func(t *testing.T) {
		for _, order := range [][]int{{0, 1, 2}, {2, 0, 1}, {1, 2, 0}} {
			path := newPath(t, "theory_acknowledged", "quiz_passed", "practice_completed")
			lastUpdate := path.UpdatedAt
			for _, i := range order {
				fact := factFor(path, i)
				fact.OccurredAt = path.CreatedAt.Add(time.Duration(i+1) * time.Microsecond)
				apply(t, fact)
				current := load(t, path)
				if current.UpdatedAt.Before(lastUpdate) {
					t.Fatal("late fact regressed processing timestamp")
				}
				lastUpdate = current.UpdatedAt
			}
			item := load(t, path).Items[0]
			if item.Status != domain.LearningPathItemCompleted {
				t.Fatalf("order %v did not complete", order)
			}
			for _, r := range item.FrozenRequirements {
				if !r.Satisfied {
					t.Fatalf("order %v lost fact", order)
				}
			}
		}
	})
	t.Run("H_frozen_assignment_readback", func(t *testing.T) {
		path := newPath(t, "practice_completed")
		snapshot := load(t, path)
		if snapshot.Items[0].LessonRevisionID != path.Items[0].LessonRevisionID || snapshot.Items[0].FrozenRequirements[0].ID != path.Items[0].FrozenRequirements[0].ID {
			t.Fatal("revision/requirement identity changed on persistence")
		}
	})
	t.Run("authoritative_Practice_ingest_mastery_closure_and_replay", func(t *testing.T) {
		path := newPath(t, "practice_completed")
		item := path.Items[0]
		requirement := item.FrozenRequirements[0]
		now := time.Now().UTC()
		instanceID, evidenceID := uuid.NewString(), uuid.NewString()
		actions := postgres.LearningActionLifecycleRepoPG{Pool: pool}
		reserve, err := domain.NormalizePracticeLearningActionReserve(domain.PracticeLearningActionReserve{
			Schema: domain.StudentPracticeLearningActionReserveSchema, StudentID: path.StudentID,
			TaskInstanceID: instanceID, TaskRevisionID: requirement.SourceReference.RevisionID,
			TaskRevisionDigest: "sha256:" + strings.Repeat("b", 64), SurfaceClassification: "practice",
			LearningPathID: path.ID, LearningPathItemID: item.ID, RequirementID: requirement.ID,
			IdempotencyKey: instanceID, LearningActionID: uuid.NewString(), LearningTargets: item.Targets, OccurredAt: now,
		})
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		binding, replayed, err := actions.ReservePracticeLearningAction(ctx, reserve)
		if err != nil || replayed || binding.LearningPathItemID != item.ID || binding.RequirementID != requirement.ID {
			t.Fatalf("reserve binding=%+v replayed=%v err=%v", binding, replayed, err)
		}
		binding, replayed, err = actions.OpenPracticeLearningAction(ctx, path.StudentID, instanceID, binding.LearningActionID, now.Add(time.Second))
		if err != nil || replayed || binding.LifecycleStatus != domain.PracticeLearningActionOpen {
			t.Fatalf("open binding=%+v replayed=%v err=%v", binding, replayed, err)
		}
		evidence, err := domain.NormalizePracticeCompetencyEvidenceBundleV2(path.StudentID, instanceID, evidenceID, domain.PracticeCompetencyEvidenceBundleV2{
			Schema: domain.PracticeCompetencyEvidenceSchemaV2, EvidenceID: evidenceID, LearningActionID: binding.LearningActionID,
			StudentID: path.StudentID, TaskInstanceID: instanceID, TaskRevisionID: reserve.TaskRevisionID,
			TaskRevisionDigest: reserve.TaskRevisionDigest, WorkspaceDigest: "sha256:" + strings.Repeat("c", 64),
			SubmissionID: evidenceID, Outcome: "passed", AssistancePolicyVersion: "practice-assistance-v1",
			LearningPathItemID: item.ID, RequirementID: requirement.ID,
			Evidence:   []domain.PracticeCompetencyEvidence{{Target: item.Targets[0], Correctness: 1, Independence: 1, Confidence: 1, StepIDs: []string{"implementation"}}},
			OccurredAt: now.Add(2 * time.Second), PolicyVersion: domain.PracticeCompetencyEvidencePolicyV2,
		})
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		wrong := evidence
		wrong.RequirementID = uuid.NewString()
		if _, err = actions.ApplyPracticeLearningActionEvidence(ctx, wrong, now.Add(3*time.Second)); !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrConflict) {
			t.Fatalf("mismatched evidence err=%v", err)
		}
		var receipts int
		if err = pool.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT count(*) FROM student_practice_evidence_receipt WHERE evidence_id=$1`, evidenceID).Scan(&receipts); err != nil || receipts != 0 {
			t.Fatalf("rejected evidence receipt count=%d err=%v", receipts, err)
		}
		open, err := actions.GetPracticeLearningAction(ctx, path.StudentID, instanceID)
		if err != nil || open.LifecycleStatus != domain.PracticeLearningActionOpen || load(t, path).Items[0].FrozenRequirements[0].Satisfied {
			t.Fatalf("rejected evidence had side effects: binding=%+v err=%v", open, err)
		}
		inserted, err := actions.ApplyPracticeLearningActionEvidence(ctx, evidence, now.Add(3*time.Second))
		if err != nil || !inserted {
			t.Fatalf("authoritative ingest inserted=%v err=%v", inserted, err)
		}
		completed := load(t, path)
		if completed.Items[0].Status != domain.LearningPathItemCompleted || !completed.Items[0].FrozenRequirements[0].Satisfied {
			t.Fatalf("authoritative evidence did not complete exact requirement: %+v", completed.Items[0])
		}
		closed, err := actions.GetPracticeLearningAction(ctx, path.StudentID, instanceID)
		if err != nil || closed.LifecycleStatus != domain.PracticeLearningActionClosed {
			t.Fatalf("binding did not close atomically: %+v err=%v", closed, err)
		}
		inserted, err = actions.ApplyPracticeLearningActionEvidence(ctx, evidence, now.Add(4*time.Second))
		if err != nil || inserted || load(t, path).Version != completed.Version {
			t.Fatalf("authoritative replay changed aggregate: inserted=%v err=%v", inserted, err)
		}
		var raw, audit, mastery, facts int
		if err = pool.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT
            (SELECT count(*) FROM student_practice_evidence_receipt WHERE evidence_id=$1),
            (SELECT count(*) FROM student_practice_target_evidence WHERE evidence_id=$1),
            (SELECT count(*) FROM student_practice_target_mastery_audit WHERE evidence_id=$1),
            (SELECT count(*) FROM student_target_mastery WHERE student_id=$2),
            (SELECT count(*) FROM student_lesson_activity_fact WHERE item_id=$3)`, evidenceID, path.StudentID, item.ID).Scan(&receipts, &raw, &audit, &mastery, &facts); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if receipts != 1 || raw != 1 || audit != 1 || mastery != 1 || facts != 1 {
			t.Fatalf("expected one atomic receipt/evidence/audit/mastery/fact; got %d/%d/%d/%d/%d", receipts, raw, audit, mastery, facts)
		}
	})
	t.Run("I_same_lesson_twice_and_legacy_coexist", func(t *testing.T) {
		path := newPath(t, "practice_completed")
		second := path.Items[0]
		second.ID = uuid.NewString()
		second.Position = 1
		second.Status = domain.LearningPathItemPlanned
		second.FrozenRequirements = append([]domain.LessonRequirement(nil), second.FrozenRequirements...)
		second.FrozenRequirements[0].ID = uuid.NewString()
		legacy := domain.LearningPathItem{ReferenceType: "lesson", ReferenceID: path.Items[0].ReferenceID, Position: 2, Status: domain.LearningPathItemPlanned, ReasonCode: "legacy_compatibility"}
		path.Items = append(path.Items, second, legacy)
		version := path.Version
		path.Version++
		path.UpdatedAt = time.Now().UTC()
		updated, err := repo.ReplaceLearningPath(ctx, path, version)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		apply(t, factFor(updated, 0))
		got := load(t, updated)
		if got.Items[0].Status != domain.LearningPathItemCompleted || got.Items[1].Status == domain.LearningPathItemCompleted || got.Items[1].FrozenRequirements[0].Satisfied || got.Items[2].LessonRevisionID != "" {
			t.Fatalf("item correlation leaked or legacy fabricated: %+v", got.Items)
		}
	})
}

func completionProofMigrate(t *testing.T, ctx context.Context, databaseURL, directory string) {
	t.Helper()
	runner, err := migrations.New(ctx, databaseURL, directory)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer runner.Close()
	if _, err = runner.Up(ctx); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("full migration runner: %v", err)
	}
	if applied, err := runner.Up(ctx); err != nil || len(applied) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("migration replay: applied=%v err=%v", applied, err)
	}
}

func completionProofLearningPath(studentID, pathID, courseID, lessonID string, now time.Time) domain.StudentLearningPath {
	return domain.StudentLearningPath{ID: pathID, StudentID: studentID, CourseID: courseID, GoalCode: "go.backend", CurriculumRevision: "r10", PolicyVersion: domain.LearningPathPolicyVersion, PlannerPolicyVersion: "course-planner-v1", ReasonCode: "initial_plan", ReasonSummary: "completion integration proof", Status: domain.LearningPathStatusActive, Version: 1, CreatedAt: now, UpdatedAt: now, Items: []domain.LearningPathItem{{ReferenceType: "lesson", ReferenceID: lessonID, Position: 0, Status: domain.LearningPathItemReady, ReasonCode: "first_current_gap"}}}
}

func completionProofMigrationDirectory(t *testing.T) string {
	t.Helper()
	for _, p := range []string{filepath.Join("db", "migrations"), filepath.Join("..", "..", "db", "migrations")} {
		if st, e := os.Stat(p); e == nil && st.IsDir() {
			return p
		}
	}
	t.Fatal("repository migration directory not found")
	return ""
}
